packageRules.description: Base tags read pgMAJOR.MINOR-tsLINE.PATCH. Capturing the TimescaleDB line as `compatibility` stops Renovate crossing it: 2.29 dropped PostgreSQL 15, and each line already has its own Dockerfile.
A PostgreSQL major is a new Dockerfile and an export/import migration, never a bump of an existing one.

What is left is PostgreSQL and TimescaleDB patch releases. The upgrade test starts the previous release, seeds a hypertable, and asserts the new image adopts that data directory with glibc unchanged, so these can land unattended.
